targets.title: The nature, effects, and relief of mathematics anxiety.
targets.evidence_quote: The current study has two aims: The first aim is to conceptually replicate the finding of the meta-analysis by 【10†Hembree (1990)】 that math anxiety is higher for elementary school teachers than for students from other fields.
targets.outcome_quote: The current study replicated the finding that female elementary school teachers have a higher level of math anxiety in relation to female students from other fields (【10†Hembree, 1990】; 【26†Kelly & Tomhave, 1985】; 【32†Szczygieł & Cipora, 2016】).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly state that this finding replicated. Specialization is an extension; smaller effects and inconclusive Bayes factors do not override their verdict.

reasoning: New German and Belgian teacher samples re-test elevated teacher math anxiety. Three papers are explicitly named in the replication verdict. Hembree is retained because the authors explicitly designate its meta-analytic finding as their target, rather than merely citing it as background. No primary paper is uniquely identified as a substitute for that meta-analysis. Additional comparisons concerning specialization, experience and teaching attitudes are treated as secondary extensions rather than further explicit replication targets. Title and all authors match publisher full text, which includes references and appendix.
